thread:
emily: Heads-up team 1: HelioSpark case vignette + a short webinar tie-in. Goal: blog + benchmark callout + 20-min webinar demo. Need quotes and legal ok by Monday EOD.
rachel: Nice. Do we have the benchmark numbers locked? HelioSpark ran the latency benchmarks on our rtx-cluster with the 13B quantized profile, right?
tom: Correct. Results were: median p50 latency 62ms, p95 198ms, and 29% lower cost-per-token vs their prior infra. I'll paste the table in a sec.
marta: For quotes, HelioSpark prefers the product-focused line from their PM, not execs. She'll send a short soundbite. Also asked that we avoid naming specific cloud instances in the public post.
emily: Noted. Rachel, can you draft hero sentence that mentions the latency + cost angle without instance names? Something like: "we cut median inference latency and lowered per-token costs by nearly a third".
rachel: Drafting: "With Redwood Inference we reduced median inference latency while lowering per-token costs by ~29% during a controlled benchmark." Thoughts?
legal-bot: Reminder: any benchmark claims must be supported by internal benchmark artifacts. Upload the run id and anonymized config. Avoid words like "guarantee" or "always".
tom: Adding run details: run_id: HS-2026-03-08-7, models: 13B-qtz-v2 (3 variants), sequence: 1024 tokens, sample size: 10k requests. I'll attach CSV to the PR.
emily: Great. Marta, will the PM quote be ready by Monday noon? We need it for the webinar promo.
marta: Yes, PM committed to "one 25-35 word quote" by Monday 10:30. Also asked for a short 30s on-camera clip — marketing to provide prompts.
rachel: For the webinar: agenda suggestion - 1) 7-min benchmark walk-through, 2) 8-min integration demo, 3) 5-min Q&A. We can route inbound sign-ups to SDRs via HubSpot form with tag=heliospark-case-webinar.
tom: I'll add a short benchmark slide and a reproducibility note: "benchmarks run under controlled conditions; results may vary by workload."
emily: Perfect. Legal-bot, once Tom uploads the run artifact, can you give a pre-approval token for the claim language?
legal-bot: Will review. Need the run artifact + customer sign-off email. Expected turnaround ~4 business hours after upload.
calendar-bot: Scheduling note 1: promo draft review Tue 09:30-10:00 scheduled. Webinar target date Thu 2026-03-19 10:00 PT.
emily: Checklist: 1) Upload benchmark CSV + config (Tom) 2) PM quote and 30s clip (Marta) 3) Draft blog + social promos (Rachel) 4) Legal sign-off (Legal-bot) 5) HubSpot form + SDR routing (Tom). Deadline Monday EOD for publish queue.
marta: Adding: customer requested embargo until the webinar runs. They want case post live same day as webinar replay.
emily: Okay, embargo noted. We'll align launch and replay email. Tom, please include lead routing instructions in the HubSpot form notes.
tom: Will do. I'll cc SDR lead in the form so they get the tag alerts.
emily: Thanks all. If anything slips, call it out here. :thumbsup:
